summary.text: Isabella Schiffler, also known as Bella, is an independent candidate for the Idaho House of Representatives, District 26A, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she has interned in the Idaho Legislature for four years and is running outside the political parties.

paragraphs.text: Isabella Schiffler graduated from Jerome High School and earned an associate degree from Bradford Christian College in 2026, according to Ballotpedia.
In her survey responses, Schiffler described her campaign as grounded in her Christian faith.
She listed opposition to abortion, support for the right to bear arms and changes to education among her key messages.
